summary_md: **Arnaud Mercier - #Entrepreneur #Versailles ([@arnaudmercier](https://x.com/arnaudmercier/status/2115742082002247747))** covers the same *Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?* paper ([arXiv 2610.37649](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.37649v1)), describing the LongChang framework that generates simulated worlds with modified physics (such as heavier objects falling slower) to test whether models notice anomalies and find the law unprompted.
